{"id":1516817963,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737547449,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1516817963/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"14.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n        int row=0 , i=0;\n        bool direction = 1;\n\n        vector<string> zigzag(numRows);\n        if(numRows == 1) return s;\n\n        while(i<s.size())\n        {\n            if(direction == 1)\n            {\n                while(i<s.size() && row < numRows)\n                {\n                    zigzag[row++].push_back(s[i++]);\n                }\n                row = row-2;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                while(i<s.size() && row >= 0)\n                {\n                    zigzag[row--].push_back(s[i++]);\n                }\n                row = 1;\n            }\n            direction = !direction;\n        }\n        string ans = \"\";\n        for(auto str : zigzag)\n        {\n            ans += str;\n        }\n    return ans ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":232}
